common:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a single handcrafted supporting scene beneath a Harmonia workflow; NOT an entire UI mockup. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its softly modeled blue-and-white clay/paper illustrations and friendly human proportions, but create the completely new composition described below. Do not copy the reference infographic or its paired-avatar layout.
Render one carefully art-directed coherent environmental vignette, not a pair of isolated busts. Editorial storytelling, gentle material detail, delicate ambient shadows, white background that fades seamlessly at all edges, navy hair and cobalt/pale-blue accents, warm natural skin. Keep central action comfortably readable at 350 CSS pixels wide. Landscape 1536x1024. Fill the central 85% with the scene, maintaining white breathing room. No border, no chart, no arrows, no UI, no text, no letters, no numbers, no bubbles, no logos, no watermark. No baked-in success ticks, green approval states or implied completed transactions. This is context for changing HTML dialogue and observed outcomes, not execution evidence.
Scene direction:

scenes.purchase-approved: A PROPERTY VISIT. Three-quarter view of Alice, a young woman with navy shoulder-length hair and blue sweater, sitting on the broad front steps of a small white riverside house with cobalt roof. Her laptop is balanced on her knees as she prepares her offer. Ben, a young man with dark short hair and white shirt, stands to one side looking at a blank property folder. A small river and two soft trees recede behind the house. One coherent intimate scene, with diagonal steps anchoring it; not separated floating portraits.
scenes.purchase-missing: AN EMPTY PLACE IN THE OFFER. Close overhead view of an estate agents light oak desk. A woman buyer hand holds open a pale blue folder with a conspicuously empty document sleeve; an agent hand rests beside the sleeve, pausing. A tiny white house model, uncapped pen and blue lamp establish the property office. Focus on the missing prerequisite, not faces or a sad facial expression. No approval marks.
scenes.purchase-rejected: A QUIET PAUSE AFTER THE BANK DECISION. Alice in a blue sweater sits alone on a curved bench outside a small white bank facade. Her closed laptop rests beside her, hands relaxed around a plain envelope, contemplative rather than theatrical distress. Pale navy bank windows, one small tree. Side-on wide composition, lots of white. No red cross, no success symbols.
scenes.purchase-reused-proof: A RESULT CANNOT BE SPENT TWICE. Close angled desk still life: an estate agent hand gently holds back a second offer folder while an already-filed document is visible through the first closed folder clear pocket. Two miniature white house models at different depths. The focus is on the same single document and two proposed destinations, a careful pause rather than an enacted second transaction. No duplicated document, no stamp, no readable writing.
scenes.purchase-wrong-buyer: WHOSE RESULT IS THIS? Over-the-shoulder composition from a property agent at a desk, comparing two simple portrait identity cards: one depicts Alice with navy shoulder-length hair, the other a clearly different short-haired adult. Alice waits across the desk. Cards have no words or numbers; a plain house-shaped paperweight anchors the scene. Visual focus on identity comparison, no fake verification symbols.
scenes.purchase-wrong-continuation: THE WRONG NEXT ACTION. A bank clerk at a small round desk compares a folder with a tiny house symbol against a separate folder with a simple document-tray symbol. A single result card is still in the clerk hand between the folders, undecided. White bank wall softly fades away. Diagonal close composition emphasizing purpose matching, not a flowchart.
scenes.purchase-wrong-issuer: WHICH BANK ISSUED IT? A property agent studies a plain document seal under a round magnifying glass. In the background, two miniature bank facades of clearly different architecture sit apart: one classical columns, one modern arched windows. The seal has a simple geometric shape, no lettering. Hands, desk and architecture comparison dominate this precise editorial vignette.
scenes.purchase-wrong-subject: WHICH PROPERTY DOES IT BELONG TO? Alice and Sofia, a woman with dark bob and white blouse, lean over a rolled-out property plan on a kitchen island. Two small model houses are visibly different, one cobalt pitched roof and one flat roof with balcony. Sofia points to the second model while Alice holds a plain result folder. Looking and comparing, no handed-over keys or completed sale.
scenes.financing-approved: THE FINANCING CONSULTATION. A friendly bank adviser in navy jacket and Alice sit at a small rounded desk under a tall arched bank window. An open folder stays on the adviser side while Alice considers her laptop. Warm focused body language, a compact potted tree, pale blue floor shadow. Medium side view as one coherent little room; no stamps or ticks.
scenes.already-approved: ONE APPROVAL IS ONE TRANSITION. Close intimate view of a bank archivist sliding one blue financing folder into a single occupied shelf slot. His other hand pauses above the same folder rather than creating a copy. Only three shelf cubbies, restrained scene with a desk corner and ceramic cup. Focus on one existing record, no multiple bank portraits or labels.
scenes.workflow-approved: FOLLOWING AN AGREED PLAN. Three-quarter overhead view of a bank adviser and a buyer at opposite ends of an oval table. Between them lies one folded accordion plan with a few blank panels; both follow the same page with a fingertip. A small laptop sits closed at the edge. The plan remains under review, no checked boxes. Circular collaborative composition.
scenes.workflow-rejected: AUTHORITY STILL MATTERS. At a bank service counter, a buyer reaches toward an application folder that remains behind the counter on the bank adviser side. The adviser calmly holds a hand just above the folder, explaining a boundary without confrontation. Architectural counter makes the separation intuitive. Side elevation, few objects, white and pale blue.
scenes.adapter-approved: CONNECTING AN EXISTING APPLICATION. A software engineer in rolled-up blue sleeves works at a small electronics bench with a sturdy old white terminal and a slim modern tablet. He is fitting one small cobalt connector between them, still in his hands. A soft desk lamp and two carefully placed tools. Tactile interface metaphor, no mechanical complexity or floating flowchart.
scenes.adapter-rejected: A CONNECTOR DOES NOT GRANT AUTHORITY. Close view of a white legacy terminal on a workbench, an attached blue adapter module, and a small closed lock beside the terminal input. An engineer hand pauses with a plain application card. The composition is about the original application retaining its gate even with an adapter. No red alarm, no success marks.
scenes.generated-approved: BUILDING THE ADAPTER FROM A REVIEWED SHAPE. Overhead technical craft table with a pale-blue measured paper template, a plain white application block, and a small precisely fitted blue adapter piece held by a developer. A simple caliper and two aligned paper sheets. Quiet careful making, no source-code text, no robot, no factory production line.
scenes.generated-rejected: GENERATED CODE CANNOT OVERRIDE THE APPLICATION. A developer kneels beside a transparent pale-blue adapter housing around a small white application safe. Its original round lock remains closed and clearly visible through the housing. The developer examines it thoughtfully with a tablet. Three-quarter low view, compact sculptural scene, no cables everywhere.
scenes.private-approval: A PRIVATE REVIEW, A NARROW HANDOFF. Cutaway corner of a quiet bank office: a banker works behind a frosted glass partition with a closed document cabinet, while Alice waits just outside holding an empty slim sleeve for a single result. The whole scene is one space joined by a small service opening. No private paper crosses the boundary; no enacted approval symbols.
scenes.live-handoff: TWO PEOPLE, TWO WORKSPACES. A single continuous diagonal shared desk spans a banker working on a desktop at one end and Alice using a laptop at the other, separated by a low translucent privacy screen. Their screens show only neutral blue rectangles, no checkmarks. A plain narrow document tray sits in the middle. Their coordinated attention, not duplicated portraits, tells the story.
scenes.branch-approved: THE APPROVAL PATH NEEDS BOTH PEOPLE. A bank adviser stands at one end of a gently forked consultation table with two open workstations on the same side, one for financing, one for a buyer review. A closed plain folder rests on the unused return ledge. Use table architecture to suggest selected parallel responsibilities, not arrows or a diagram. Calm, warm, no completed status.
scenes.branch-declined: CLOSURE IS ALSO A PATH. A bank adviser carefully puts a plain application folder into a blue archive box on a low cabinet; the buyer stands beside a clear doorway with her coat over her arm. The room stays gentle and dignified, no melodrama. This is a story about recording closure, not losing all progress. Side-on architectural composition.
scenes.sequence-complete: THE REVIEW FOLLOWS THE DECISION. Alice reads an open folder at a quiet window seat inside a bank, with an adviser in the distant background at another desk. Her finger follows one blank line of the document, laptop tucked beside her. Foreground review and background bank work are linked by the same room depth. No approval badge.
scenes.sequence-resumed: RETURNING TO WHERE WE LEFT OFF. Evening desk by a pale-blue window: Alice hangs her jacket on the chair with one hand and opens her laptop with the other. Beside it, the same open notebook has a blue ribbon bookmark holding the current page. A desk lamp pools warm white light. Reconnection as continuity, no loading spinners or repeated avatar pair.
scenes.composer-direct: AGREE BEFORE ACTING. Top-down view of two people hands arranging a few large blank task cards on a shared table before signing the plan. One sleeve navy bank jacket, one Alice blue sweater. A capped pen lies between them, one laptop partly visible, no checks. A deliberate human negotiation, generous clean space, no floating button-like cards.
scenes.composer-generated: A DIFFERENT ORDER, THE SAME APPLICATION. Three-quarter view of a buyer and bank adviser seated side by side moving a folded plan on a desk beside a compact existing white application terminal. One blue adapter piece connects the terminal physically, and the buyer points to the first blank panel in the reordered plan. One cohesive workspace, no checkmarks.
scenes.package-builder: BRING AN APPLICATION TO THE WORKSHOP. Wide little workshop scene: a developer unpacks a single white application module from a blue archival transport box onto a workbench. A laptop, a folded specification sheet and one matching blue connector are laid out carefully. The module is still being inspected; no green success light. A human at work, generous white surroundings.
scenes.execution-boundaries: TWO REQUESTS REACH ONE PLACE. Close top-down mechanical desk metaphor: two different hands approach the same single narrow document slot with two identical plain cards, neither inserted yet. A single card-sized receiving tray below makes the one-place capacity evident. Cobalt slot surround, white wood desk. No winner, no race flags, no numeric labels.
scenes.transfer-approved: A COORDINATED CUSTODY HANDOFF. Two custodians in different blue jackets face each other across a long white secure counter with a single transparent lockbox of blue tokens in the middle. Each has a separate small terminal and a key still on their own side. Wide three-quarter view with a pale-blue arched storage alcove behind. Preparation rather than enacted arrival, no money signs.
scenes.transfer-final-leg-rejected: THE ASSET STAYS AT THE SOURCE. A custodian stands at a secure source vault with a closed clear lockbox of blue tokens. Across a short connecting counter, a second destination hatch is visibly shut. The custodian checks the closed destination while keeping the lockbox at the source. Side-on cutaway, clear physical separation, no token trail or successful transfer.
scenes.transfer-missing-agreement: THE OWNER HAS NOT AGREED. A seller with dark shoulder-length hair sits across from a custodian at a secure reception desk. An unsigned blank agreement and a capped pen remain in the middle; a clear lockbox of blue tokens is still behind the custodian. Her hands are folded, no signature implied. Quiet eye-level scene about consent before movement.
scenes.transfer-missing-lock: RESERVE THE POSITION FIRST. A source custodian in rolled sleeves checks an open empty reservation cradle beside a separate sealed box of blue tokens. The box has not been placed in the cradle. Pale secure storeroom corner, just one shelf and a work surface. Close three-quarter composition centered on the unprepared cradle.
scenes.transfer-missing-readiness: THE RECEIVING SIDE IS STILL PREPARING. A destination custodian crouches by a closed receiving cabinet arranging its empty tray, while a source custodian waits at a distant counter with a blue token box. The recipient preparation is the foreground action; no asset crosses. Perspective emphasizes the gap and patient coordination, not a flowchart.
scenes.transfer-source-settler: THE SOURCE CUSTODIAN COORDINATES SETTLEMENT. A source custodian stands at a central angled console in a bright secure room, one hand poised over its neutral screen, looking across to a destination custodian at a receiving desk. A sealed token box rests at the source. A small seller folder lies on the console. View over the source shoulder, no completed transfer indicators.

explanations.evidence-review: REVIEW THE EVIDENCE. Top-down quiet review desk. Two different sets of hands compare an original input folder, a narrow expected-results sheet and an observed-results sheet side by side, all without readable text. One blue pencil points between the two sheets, a small magnifying glass at the edge. Thoughtful assessment, no thumbs up or checked verdict. Hands and documents, no floating avatars.
explanations.release-preparation: PREPARING FOR ANOTHER TEAM. Three-quarter view of an engineer carefully packing a white application module, a folded guide and a blue connector into a modest open carrying case. A colleague waits at the door with a plain notebook. The kit is being prepared, not universally adopted; no celebration or approval mark. Warm purposeful pose, generous white background.
explanations.original-reading: READING THE ORIGINAL COMMITMENTS. A thoughtful woman with navy hair and pale-blue shirt sits at a broad angled reading desk. Two substantial source volumes are open on the desk, one with a blue ribbon bookmark and one with slim annotation slips. She follows a passage with a fingertip while keeping a separate slim notebook at the side. Pages contain only faint neutral lines, no text. Three-quarter library nook fading to white, no institutional logos.
explanations.source-workbench: UNDERSTANDING THE MODULES. Isometric architect-like worktable with a developer studying three small open room modules, neatly grouped and separated by clear space, while a colleague traces their physical connecting walkway with a fingertip. A single folded plan and compact laptop at the edge. Tangible coherent architectural model of responsibility boundaries, not a computer network diagram, not repeated portraits.
